title: Acceptance on a fully true input
statement: Let $B$ be a language of Boolean strings, and let $x,w$ be Boolean strings with $|x|+3\le |w|$. After the machine runs on the choice string $w$ from its initial configuration on input $x$, it is halted; its output is the one-bit string $[1]$ exactly when every bit of $x$ is true and the prefix of $w$ of length $|x|$ belongs to $B$.
hypotheses_covered: B is a language of Boolean strings
x and w are Boolean strings
